doors.label: Tax cap
doors.sentence: Named YES on the 7 May 2026 budget (7.28 overall / 9.34 residential). "They want to protect the things that we love in the city." No cap, formula or glide path. The 2023–25 "lowest of most surrounding cities" line is a comparative frame, not a restraint rule.

doors.label: Downtown order
doors.sentence: Campaign Record page: started OUR DWTN (cleanliness, safety, events) and supported the Community Safety and Wellbeing Plan. No Public Order Team and no 6am–10pm bylaw hours. 2026 "keep investing in community safety and wellbeing" is scored nowhere as M26/M27.

doors.label: Housing
doors.sentence: "We need to get back on track and speed up new rental, affordable, social and market housing. I commit to making that happen as soon as possible." No unit target and no 25/20/15 mix. Record: named YES on Missing Middle, 26 Jan 2023.

doors.label: Written program
doors.sentence: Authorized 2026 re-election site with a policies page (eight themes) plus a Record page. Directional, not costed, no tax formula, no permit benchmark, no dashboard, no $25M threshold.

cells.quote: We need to get back on track and speed up new rental, affordable, social and market housing. I commit to making that happen as soon as possible.
cells.why: Commits to a supply mix with no unit target and no composition share. Record, matching, not a second mark: named YES on Missing Middle 26 Jan 2023 ("Council members in favour of the program — Jeremy Caradonna, Dave Thompson, Susan Kim, Krista Loughton, Matt Dell and Mayor Marianne Alto"). Family Housing Policy / 3-bedroom incentive on the Record page is the same supply cell, not a second mark. Not a sourced miss, so no Close cap. The 9,000-units figure is campaign-attributed, not an ACTW number, and is not stamped.

cells.quote: Campaign Record page: "Reduced development cost charges for affordable housing by 100%." No named Dell yes/no opened this pass.
cells.why: No 2026 vacancy target or suite amnesty. Shown, not scored. Do not invent a roll-call.

cells.what: drug-use buffer (City: list + bylaw/DPOT + VicPD/CDSA; not City seizure)

cells.quote: Campaign Record page: "Ended sheltering in Topaz, Stadacona, Vic West, Irving, Central, Hollywood and Beacon Hill park by hiring a Housing Relocation Coordinator to work with people to find suitable homes.
cells.why: No 2026 continue-sentence and no named Dell yes/no opened this pass. Shown, not scored. Night lighting is not named.

cells.what: tax glide path (capped on the residential rate)
cells.quote: Voting for the budget were councillors Matt Dell, Jeremy Caradonna, Chris Coleman, Dave Thompson, Krista Loughton and Mayor Marianne Alto.
cells.why: Adopted 7.28 overall / 9.34 residential. Disagrees with a residential-rate cap. Context, same debate, not a second mark: "They want to protect the things that we love in the city." / "If you want to cut the budget, put forward programs people love." 2026 policies are silent on a cap. The 2023–25 "lowest municipal tax increase of most surrounding major cities" claim is a comparative frame, not a restraint instrument, and is not scored here.

business, downtown, one mandate not a new office
cells.quote: More supports for local business and tourism.
cells.why: Commits to downtown-business support with no vacancy target and no one-mandate-not-a-new-office. Record page downtown tax-reduction / facade / Douglas funds are matching context, not a second mark. OUR DWTN cleanliness is row 26.

Host Nations Foundation. Topic never drops out of the 12. A dash is still allowed on M1–M5.
cells.quote: I support the City's commitment to Reconciliation with the Esquimalt and Songhees Nation, and will work collaboratively with local First Nations to implement the Truth and Reconciliation Commission's Calls to Action.
cells.why: Commits to a City TRC-implementation action. No standing government-to-government table, no procurement target, no place-name programme, no urban Indigenous liaison. The homepage lək̓ʷəŋan acknowledgement is not a second mark. Professional / volunteer background is not a source. Record-page PEERS Indigenous-led return programme is not this Foundation package and is not scored here.

cells.what: tenant protections, STR, indoor heat (M9c struck; 26°C gated)
cells.quote: To do this, we must accelerate construction of non-market housing, build thousands of new rental units, and strengthen policies to protect renters.
cells.why: Commits to renter-protection policy. Neither: no demoviction bylaw named, no STR licensing, no indoor-heat standard in the 2026 sentence. Housing-supply clauses in the same sentence are not a second M6 mark. Record, matching, not a second mark: Tenant Protection Bylaw on the Record page; 30 Jul 2026 council unanimously enhanced compensation (press 31 Jul 2026) and Dell is quoted that "continuing to approve rental developments will have a bigger impact on helping renters." M9c is struck; 26°C is gated — a May 2026 heat motion is not scored in this cluster.

cells.quote: Campaign Record page: "Approved 517 units of shelter and supportive housing for individuals experiencing homelessness." No Housing First target, no STEP throughput, no quarterly count.
cells.why: No 2026 Dell-owned Housing First sentence. Shown, not scored.

cells.what: childcare, doctors, youth (M13 school food is $0 → M13d)

cells.quote: Campaign Record page: "Started the OUR DWTN program, which invests nearly $900,000 annually into downtown cleanliness, safety and cultural events.
cells.why: No 2026 "continue OUR DWTN" sentence (unlike Loughton). No 90% graffiti standard, no sanitation hours. Shown, not scored. Arts/events in the same Record bullet are not a second M50 mark.

cells.what: mobility + Vision Zero (M39 30 km/h struck; calming is M38)
cells.quote: Expand clean and active transportation options and public transit - so everyone can get around Victoria easily and at reasonable cost.
cells.why: Commits to active transportation. Neither: no adaptive-signal programme, no Vision Zero audit, no named corridor. Transit in the same sentence is not a second M20b/M23b mark. Record AAA cycling / bike share / bike valet is matching context, not a second mark. M39 is struck — not scored. A 2023 speed-camera motion Dell seconded is Record context on this cluster, not a 2026 instrument and not scored again.

cells.what: walking and transit the City controls
cells.quote: Invest in streets, sidewalks & infrastructure.
cells.why: Commits to sidewalk and street investment. Neither: no sidewalk-gap standard and no City-controlled transit-lever list. Distinct home-page bullet from the active-transportation sentence on row 27. "Fix roads first" sequencing is row 30, not here. "Walkable" on other bullets is branding and is not scored again.

cells.quote: Campaign Record page: "Committed $14 million dollars to rebuild every public washroom in Victoria.
cells.why: No 2026 washroom-count or accessibility-audit sentence. No named Dell yes/no opened this pass. Shown, not scored.

cells.quote: Campaign Record page: "Supported funding for a business-security fund, a facade improvement fund, and a Douglas street revitalization fund." No named Dell yes/no opened this pass.
cells.why: Downtown-business 2026 sentence is scored on row 18. Shown, not scored.

cells.what: VicPD funding + regional review (convene-and-publish; no binding other force)
safety dashboard, published enforcement record, crime target

cells.quote: To do this, we must implement strategies in cooperation with the arts community, preserve important venues and provide grant funding for diverse artists to create work for the public.
cells.why: Commits to cultural-venue preservation. Comparable, not Same: heritage standards and a street-furniture programme are not named. Grant funding in the same sentence is not a second M50 mark. Record, matching, not a second mark: "purchased Hermann's Jazz Club to ensure there's a place for arts and music downtown" (VicNews launch 31 Dec 2025 / Victoria Buzz 5 Jan 2026). Royal and McPherson board seat is a seat held, not a source. Not a sourced miss, so no Close cap. FLAG: a reader could argue Partial 1.0 because heritage standards are absent; ambiguity resolves upward.

cells.quote: Campaign Record page: "Supported pedestrianized areas across the city, including lower Government Street and other neighbourhood led spaces.
cells.why: No 2026 pedestrian-priority or signature-project sentence. "Walkable neighbourhoods" on the home page is branding, not pedestrianisation. Shown, not scored.

cells.quote: We need to preserve green space and invest in new parks with inclusive amenities, and we must invest in recreation facilities for everyone – such as a new Crystal Pool and Central Library.
cells.why: Commits to new parks investment. Neither: no heritage-incentive schedule, no ornamental-lighting programme. Crystal Pool in this sentence is context; the dated 2030 completion is scored on row 39. FLAG: home-page "more parks & trees" is a different sentence, scored on row 49.

cells.what: culture, sport, and the arts funding floor
cells.quote: Finish Crystal Pool by 2030.
cells.why: Commits to a recreation-facility completion date. Neither: no arts-funding-floor percentage. Context, not a second mark: home-page "More events like Symphony Splash and Fernfest" / "Champion arts and culture"; grant-funding clause already used on row 36. City referendum 8 Feb 2025 is a voter result, not a named Dell vote. Unanimous site-endorsement press does not name Dell this pass — do not invent a roll-call.

cells.what: local-tech procurement, open data, Wi-Fi, EV charging

cells.quote: Advocate for policies that promote green building technologies, reduce waste and move towards a circular economy.
cells.why: Commits to a municipal climate/building instrument. Neither: not the 50% / 2030 target set, not district energy, not seismic. Context, same policies section, not scored separately: "I am committed to doing everything possible to reduce emissions in Victoria." Record Climate Leadership Plan update / Zero Carbon Step-code is matching context, not a second mark. "Climate leadership stated" as a characterisation is not a source.

cells.what: trees, mode share, ecosystems, emergency preparedness
cells.quote: Climate-smart city with more parks & trees.
cells.why: Commits to more trees. Neither: no 5,000-tree target, no 35% canopy in the 2026 bullet, no emergency-preparedness position. Record page "Committed to a 40% Urban Tree canopy by 2050 (up from 30%)" is matching context, not a second mark. Mode share sits inside the sentence already scored on row 27. FLAG: parks also appear on row 38 from a different sentence.

cells.what: neighbourhoods, language access, Local Area Plans
cells.quote: We can do this by creating innovative local plans, in consultation with communities, to ensure each neighbourhood is unique, walkable and vibrant.
cells.why: Commits to local plans with community consultation. Comparable, not Same: language-access and a neighbourhood-grant line are not named. "Walkable" in the same sentence is not a second M20b/M45b mark. Fernwood / James Bay liaison on the City biography is a seat held, not a source. Not a sourced miss, so no Close cap. FLAG: a reader could argue Partial 1.0 (local plans ≠ the Local Area Plan programme) or Aligned 3.0 (same instrument); ambiguity between Partial and Close resolves upward to Close, not to Aligned, because the rest of the cluster is absent.

cells.what: community surveys, turnout and ballot access
Saanich amalgamation (one line, not the whole topic)
cells.quote: Councillors Chris Coleman, Matt Dell, Krista Loughton and Susan Kim sided with the mayor
cells.why: to put "Do you support Saanich and Victoria becoming one municipality?" on the ballot, 5–4. Record-only hit vs M81. No 2026 Dell-owned execute-amalgamation sentence (unlike Loughton's "structural framework to execute it"). Not Close/Aligned. Policies page is silent on amalgamation.
